title: Electrician Course CBT Level II & III
description: Comprehensive practical training covering residential wiring, industrial motor controls, circuit breakers, safety protocols, and renewable solar PV installation. Electrician's work is physically demanding, preparing students for high-demand local and overseas job markets.

title: Plumbing Course CBT Level II & III
description: Learn modern plumbing systems, sanitary installations, piping layout, pipe threading, PVC/PPR fittings, booster pump maintenance, and water supply infrastructure. 80% hands-on workshop experience.

title: Welding Course CBT Level II
description: Enhance industrial welding capabilities with SMAW (Shielded Metal Arc Welding), MIG/MAG, oxy-acetylene cutting, structural joint fabrication, and strict industrial safety standards.

title: Computer Applications Course
description: Enable trainees to master the modern computer world: Microsoft Office Suite, Operating Systems, Internet research, digital documentation, typing speed, and foundational computer troubleshooting.

title: AutoCAD Course CBT Level II & III
description: Enable trainees to perform routine skilled and semi-skilled tasks in engineering and architectural design. Master 2D drafting, 3D modelling, structural blueprints, elevations, and CAD workflows.

title: DIT Diploma (Information Technology)
description: Comprehensive Diploma in Information Technology accredited by Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Board of Technical Education (KPBTE). Includes Web Design, Databases, Networking, C++/OOP Programming, and Graphic Software.
